lines.trans: At the end of the day we sum things up.
We doubt whether we made the right choice.
Lyova, stop, please, do not do that!
Why not? The oven is simply dirty.
Well you really scared me just now!
Forgive me, I only wanted what was best.
We all worry about our setbacks.
I just wanted to say that you are really cool.
I would hang out with you even without money.
Thank you very much for the kind words.
We hope that tomorrow will be better.
Did you do everything the way we agreed?

examples.text: У меня есть машинка.
examples.trans: I have a toy car.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'everything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Не всё, что говорят, чистая правда.
examples.trans: Not everything people say is the pure truth.

examples.text: Ты будешь во всём меня слушаться.
examples.trans: You will obey me in everything.

examples.text: Может, ещё не всё потеряно?
examples.trans: Maybe not everything is lost yet?

meanings.en: to agree, to have an agreement
meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'говариваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'agreed, arranged', paired with 'договориться'.

examples.text: Мы же с вами договаривались!
examples.trans: We had an agreement!

examples.text: Мы так не договаривались.
examples.trans: That wasn't our deal.

examples.text: Как же так? Мы же с вами договаривались!
examples.trans: How can this be? We had an agreement!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Светочка, я на минутку отойду, не скучайте.
examples.trans: Svetochka, I will step away for a minute, do not be bored.

examples.text: Но тебе это точно не грозит.
examples.trans: But you are definitely in no danger of that.

examples.text: Завтрашний день точно будет лучше!
examples.trans: Tomorrow will definitely be better!
